_comment: Two entries, so the build has more than one chunk. `first.js` reads `a` through a star barrel in a deferred closure. `b.js` is a star target that the barrel re-exports, and the entry `other` imports it. `b.js` must initialize at the first deferred access, after the top level of `main.js` sets `state.value = 3`, as in native V8 (`--js-defer-import-eval`). The entry `other` must not run at startup. The `export *` statement keeps its eval flag with code splitting, because the init of a star target in another chunk is not restored for an excluded statement. Thus this output must stay as it is when tree shaking of deferred closures changes.
